# linear_project_label (Data Source)

Look up one project label or group by UUID or exact name. Name lookups search active labels; use UUID to retrieve an archived label.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linear_project_label" "release_tier" {
  name           = "Release Tier"
  workspace_only = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Exact label UUID. Specify exactly one of id or name.
- `name` (String) Exact label name. Ambiguous names produce an error.
- `parent_id` (String) Optional parent UUID to disambiguate a name.
- `team_id` (String) Optional team UUID to disambiguate a name.
- `workspace_only` (Boolean) Restrict results to workspace labels. Cannot be combined with team_id.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Hex color.
- `description` (String) Label description.
- `group_type` (String) Group selection behavior, when applicable.
- `inherited_from_id` (String) Source label UUID for an inherited copy.
- `is_group` (Boolean) Whether this label is a group.
